title: Put the Network Theme Kit photos and placeholders in the repo, byte for byte, so the kit can show them

source.ref: Daniel, 2026-10-28: program the new Network design system into the theme system the way Nocturne is. Plan: /mnt/project-files/network-theme/PLAN.html

verify.evidence: Fails on main (no public/sites/network-kit/photos) and passes here: all 19 files exist with the same sha256 as the design copies in the inventory.

detail: Pass 1a of 12. 12 photos and 7 placeholders copied unchanged from the design's assets/images into public/sites/network-kit/photos (the rules.json asset target). Nothing displays them yet. The 19 missing:assets/images ids left the network baseline, which only shrank. Per-photo focal points (IMG_FOCUS) are not ported: Nocturne keeps no equivalent data file, so the pass that renders photos decides.
